blocks.text: The Zscaler service has Secure Browsing reports, which you can run to track the use of vulnerable browsers, plugins, and applications, and then modify your Browser Control policy if needed.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Analytics > Reports > Interactive Reports.
On the Standard Reports tab, go to the Secure Browsing section to see the available browsing reports.

blocks.text: To learn more about Interactive Reports, see About Interactive Reports.

blocks.heading: Viewing Top Users with Vulnerable Browsers, Plugins, and Applications

blocks.text: Additionally, on the Web Insights page, you can view a list of the top users with vulnerable browsers, plugins, and applications. To learn more, see About Insights.
To view top users with vulnerable browsers, plugins, and applications:

blocks.item: Go to Data Explorer > Internet & SaaS > Web Insights.
At the top, choose User as the Data Type.
In the left pane, choose a time frame and chart type.
Select the Secure Browsing Status filter, and then select Vulnerable.

blocks.text: The service lists users who are using vulnerable browsers, plugins, and applications for which you set warnings.
